summary.intent: Execute Phase 24 (Bug Fixes & Test Infrastructure) using GSD wave-based parallel execution, then clean up the code, get a PR merged, and fix the resulting CI failures for the new recovery E2E test.
summary.outcome: Phase 24 was successfully executed and merged (PR #361). A recovery E2E test was added but required multiple CI fix iterations; a final fix (PR #364 + follow-up) addressing CORS on mock-ipns-routing and correct IPNS gateway routing is in progress.

repo: Device registry was migrated from v1 to v2 schema; v1 records are read leniently and migrated on write. New registries are always v2 with SHA-256 ipHash.
bin IPNS 404 is now auto-repaired via publishWithVerify on loadBin — sequenceNumber is 1 after first load, not 0.
The CipherBox API's /ipns/resolve endpoint requires JWT auth (JwtAuthGuard on entire IpnsController) — it cannot be called from unauthenticated browser tools like recovery.html.

In CI, IPNS records are published exclusively through mock-ipns-routing (port 3001) via delegated routing, NOT through Kubo's name/publish. Kubo has no knowledge of these records and cannot resolve them.
mock-ipns-routing has no CORS headers configured, blocking browser access from Playwright-driven Chromium.

recovery.html resolveIpns fallback chain: (1) /ipns/ HEAD on IPFS gateway, (2) /routing/v1/ipns/:name on IPNS gateway with retries, (3) CipherBox API /ipns/resolve (requires auth), (4) Kubo /api/v0/name/resolve POST.
The web E2E workflow was missing SDK_E2E_SECRET env var, causing 401s on /auth/test-login for the recovery spec's createTestAccount call.
Kubo's gateway (8080) and API (5001) have no CORS headers by default — browser requests from localhost:5173 are blocked without explicit ipfs config.

code.finding: publishWithVerify now publishes once then retries only verification — previously re-published on every retry attempt.
validateRegistryShape() extracted to deduplicate v1/v2 validation. After extraction, TypeScript didn't propagate array narrowing across function boundary — required 'as unknown[]' cast at call site.
cid/pinSize declared inside try block, making them inaccessible in finally. Must be hoisted above try block.
computeIpHash() exists in device/info.ts and should be used instead of inline SHA-256 for ipHash computation.
Simple Fastify server with no CORS headers — browser requests blocked. Needs Access-Control-Allow-Origin header added to all responses.
Web E2E workflow sets TEST_LOGIN_SECRET for API but not SDK_E2E_SECRET for test runner — recovery spec's createTestAccount reads SDK_E2E_SECRET.

workflow: GSD wave execution with 3 parallel subagents completed cleanly — spot-checks (SUMMARY.md, git log, Self-Check marker) are a reliable completion signal.
TypeScript errors in web app were caused by stale package builds (missing .d.ts regeneration) — rebuilding @cipherbox/crypto and @cipherbox/api-client resolved 6 errors without any code changes.
GitHub Actions job logs are sometimes unreachable via gh CLI — downloading Playwright report artifacts (error-context.md, screenshots) is more reliable for diagnosing E2E failures.

When merging a branch into main after a sibling branch was already merged, planning files (ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, PROJECT.md) will have merge conflicts that need manual resolution preserving both phases' completion data.
CodeRabbit and Copilot automated reviews caught real issues: weak test assertions, non-null assertion abuse, and env var coupling — worth triaging rather than dismissing.

friction: Recovery E2E test required 4+ CI fix iterations due to layered issues: missing SDK_E2E_SECRET → Kubo CORS → CipherBox API auth gate on /ipns/resolve → mock-ipns-routing CORS.
GitHub API/CLI was intermittently unreachable during the session, blocking log fetching and requiring artifact downloads as a workaround.
Background bash tasks with run_in_background created confusing out-of-order completion notifications, some failing with exit code 128 after the work was already done via foreground commands.
Docker host IP changed (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12) mid-session, breaking API connections and requiring .env updates.
The recovery.html resolveIpns fallback chain has a ~30s timeout on the first /ipns/ HEAD attempt before falling through — slow feedback loop when debugging.
pnpm dev was manually backgrounded by the user mid-session, causing confusion about which services were running.
open_items: Recovery E2E test fix (PR #364 follow-up) — adding CORS to mock-ipns-routing and pointing IPNS_GATEWAY to localhost:3001 — not yet merged/verified green.
recovery.html resolveIpns fallback chain is fragile for local development: requires either Kubo CORS configured or a public proxy. Consider documenting the local setup requirements.
The /ipns/resolve API endpoint requires JWT auth, preventing use from unauthenticated browser tools. Consider whether a public read-only IPNS resolution endpoint is needed.
Load test CORS for mock-ipns-routing was added inline via addHook rather than using @fastify/cors — should be formalized if mock-ipns-routing gains more usage.
byo-file-workload.ts still has pre-existing type errors unrelated to phase 24 changes.
Recovery spec uses createTestAccount from SDK E2E harness — tight coupling between web-e2e and sdk-e2e test infrastructure worth revisiting.
